usajmo-2010-q1.summary: For each $n\ge1$, count the permutations $\pi$ of $\{1,\dots,n\}$ for which $j\pi(j)$ is a square at every position $j$. What is the first $n$ for which this count is divisible by $2010$? Justify minimality.
usajmo-2010-q1.summaryZh: 对于每个正整数 $n$，统计满足下列条件的排列 $\pi$：它是 $\{1,\dots,n\}$ 的一个排列，且每个位置 $j$ 都有 $j\pi(j)$ 为完全平方数。求使排列数是 $2010$ 的倍数的最小 $n$，并证明其最小性。

methods.title: Separate the squarefree parts
methods.titleZh: 按无平方因子部分分类
steps: Write every positive integer $j$ uniquely as $d t^2$, where $d$ is squarefree. The primes with odd exponents in $j$ are precisely those dividing $d$. Thus $j\pi(j)$ is a square exactly when $j$ and $\pi(j)$ have the same $d$.

For any given $d$, its class has $\lfloor\sqrt{n/d}\rfloor$ members, which may be permuted without restriction. Different classes do not affect one another. The total count is the product of the factorials of the class sizes.

The prime factorisation is $2010=2\cdot3\cdot5\cdot67$. If $n<67^2$, even the largest class, $d=1$, has at most $66$ members, so none of these factorials is divisible by $67$. At $n=67^2$ the $d=1$ factor is $67!$, divisible by all four primes. This is the first possible value.
stepsZh: 每个正整数 $j$ 唯一写成 $d t^2$，其中 $d$ 不含平方因子。$j$ 中指数为奇数的素因数恰是整除 $d$ 的素数。因此 $j\pi(j)$ 为平方数，当且仅当两数具有相同的 $d$。
固定 $d$ 的一类共有 $\lfloor\sqrt{n/d}\rfloor$ 个数，类内可以任意排列，各个类的选择相互独立。所求总数就是各类元素个数的阶乘之积。
因 $2010=2\cdot3\cdot5\cdot67$，必须出现素因数 $67$。当 $n<67^2$ 时，最大的类（$d=1$）至多有 $66$ 个数，所有阶乘都不含 $67$。当 $n=67^2$ 时，$d=1$ 这一类贡献 $67!$，包含上述四个不同素因数，故此时首次满足。

usajmo-2010-q2.summary: Fix $n>1$. An increasing list of $n-1$ positive integers $x_1,\ldots,x_{n-1}$ has $x_i+x_{n-i}=2n$ at every index. Whenever two entries (the same one may be used twice) have sum less than $2n$, their sum also occurs in the list. Determine all such lists.
usajmo-2010-q2.summaryZh: 固定整数 $n>1$。严格递增的 $n-1$ 个正整数 $x_1,\ldots,x_{n-1}$ 满足每个指标上都有 $x_i+x_{n-i}=2n$。若两个数列项（允许重复使用同一项）的和小于 $2n$，则这个和也是数列中的一项。求所有符合条件的数列。
usajmo-2010-q2.answer: The unique list has $x_i=2i$ for $1\le i<n$.

methods.title: Translate all but the last term
methods.titleZh: 把除末项外的各项整体平移
steps: Write $d=x_1$. For $1\le i\le n-2$, the values $d+x_i$ are greater than $d$ and smaller than $d+x_{n-1}=2n$, so they must all occur in the list. They are already in increasing order.

There are exactly $n-2$ entries after $d$, so $d+x_i=x_{i+1}$ whenever $1\le i\le n-2$. Consequently $x_i=id$, and the first and last terms give $nd=2n$. This also covers $n=2$, when the recurrence is empty.

Thus $d=2$. The proposed terms $2,4,\ldots,2n-2$ are strictly increasing and pair to $2n$ under reversal. A sum below $2n$ of two such entries is another positive even number in this range, completing the converse.
stepsZh: 记 $d=x_1$。对 $1\le i\le n-2$，各数 $d+x_i$ 都大于 $d$，又小于 $d+x_{n-1}=2n$，所以都必须在原数列中出现。它们已按严格递增顺序排列。
原数列中大于 $d$ 的项恰有 $n-2$ 个，因此逐项对应有 $d+x_i=x_{i+1}$。于是 $x_i=id$，首末两项相加即得 $nd=2n$。当 $n=2$ 时递推式没有任何项，但首末配对式仍然给出同一结论。
因此 $d=2$。反过来，$2,4,\ldots,2n-2$ 严格递增，首尾对应项的和为 $2n$。两个数列项之和若小于 $2n$，必是这个范围内的正偶数，因此确实在列中。

methods.title: Use differences and the smallest member
methods.titleZh: 用差的封闭性和最小元素
steps: Let $S$ be the set of entries together with $0$ and $2n$. The reversal condition makes it invariant under $v\mapsto2n-v$. For $0<u<v<2n$ in $S$, the sum $u+(2n-v)$ is strictly below $2n$ and belongs to $S$. Reflecting it shows $v-u\in S$. The same conclusion for endpoints follows from $0\in S$ and reflection.

Take the smallest positive member $d$. Repeatedly subtracting $d$ from each member until its remainder lies in $[0,d)$ shows the remainder lies in $S$ and must be $0$. In particular $d$ divides $2n$. Repeated subtraction from $2n$ also produces every multiple of $d$ from $0$ to $2n$.

Hence $S$ has $2n/d+1$ members. Its defining list and the two endpoints give $n+1$ members, so $d=2$. Conversely the even numbers between the endpoints satisfy both conditions, giving the stated list.
stepsZh: 将所有数列项连同 $0,2n$ 组成集合 $S$。由首尾配对可知映射 $v\mapsto2n-v$ 将 $S$ 映回自身。若 $0<u<v<2n$ 且二者都在 $S$ 中，则 $u+(2n-v)<2n$，这个和也在 $S$ 中。再取关于 $n$ 的对称数，得到 $v-u\in S$。当 $u=0$ 或 $v=2n$ 时，同样结论由定义或对称性直接成立。
设 $d$ 为 $S$ 中最小正数。从每个元素反复减去 $d$，直至余数落入 $[0,d)$；由上述性质，余数仍在 $S$ 中，只能为零。特别地，$d$ 整除 $2n$。从 $2n$ 开始依次减 $d$，还说明区间内 $d$ 的每个倍数均属于 $S$。
因此 $S$ 的元素个数既为 $2n/d+1$，又等于 $n-1$ 个数列项加两个端点，即 $n+1$，故 $d=2$。反过来，端点之间的全部正偶数显然满足对称和加法条件。

usajmo-2010-q3.summary: Start with a diameter $AB$ and choose three more points on one semicircle, in arc order $A,X,Y,Z,B$. Project $Y$ perpendicularly onto the four lines $AX,BX,AZ,BZ$, calling the feet $P,Q,R,S$ in that order. If $O$ is the circle centre, show the smaller angle between $PQ$ and $RS$ equals $\angle XOZ/2$.
usajmo-2010-q3.summaryZh: 以 $AB$ 为直径作圆，在同一半圆上依弧序取五个不同的点 $A,X,Y,Z,B$。从 $Y$ 向直线 $AX,BX,AZ,BZ$ 分别作垂线，垂足依次为 $P,Q,R,S$。设圆心为 $O$，证明直线 $PQ$ 与 $RS$ 所成的锐角等于 $\angle XOZ$ 的一半。

methods.title: Reflect directions in two rectangles
methods.titleZh: 用两组正交坐标反射直线方向
steps: Measure line directions modulo $\pi$. Since $AB$ is a diameter, $AX\perp BX$. Use those lines as coordinate axes through $X$. If $Y=(u,v)$, its feet are $(u,0)$ and $(0,v)$, so a direction of $PQ$ is $(u,-v)$: its line is the reflection of $XY$ in $AX$. The same construction at $Z$ shows that $RS$ is the reflection of $ZY$ in $AZ$.

Write $\theta(L)$ for the direction of line $L$. Reflection in a line of direction $h$ takes a direction $t$ to $2h-t$. Thus the directed angle from $PQ$ to $RS$ is $2(\theta(AZ)-\theta(AX))-(\theta(ZY)-\theta(XY))$ modulo $\pi$.

Both parenthesised differences are the same directed inscribed angle subtending chord $XZ$, one measured at $A$ and the other at $Y$. Denote that common residue by $\alpha$. The difference of reflected directions is $2\alpha-\alpha=\alpha$.

The arc from $X$ through $Y$ to $Z$ is shorter than a semicircle, so the ordinary angle $\angle XAZ$ is acute and equals half its central angle $\angle XOZ$. This selects the smaller angle between the lines.
stepsZh: 把直线方向视为模 $\pi$ 的角。因 $AB$ 为直径，$AX\perp BX$。以 $X$ 为原点、这两直线为坐标轴，若 $Y=(u,v)$，两垂足就是 $(u,0),(0,v)$。所以 $PQ$ 可取方向向量 $(u,-v)$，即直线 $XY$ 关于 $AX$ 反射后的方向。同理，直线 $RS$ 的方向是 $ZY$ 关于 $AZ$ 的反射。
记 $\theta(L)$ 为直线 $L$ 的方向角。沿方向角为 $h$ 的直线反射，会把方向角 $t$ 改为 $2h-t$。因此从 $PQ$ 到 $RS$ 的有向角模 $\pi$ 等于 $2(\theta(AZ)-\theta(AX))-(\theta(ZY)-\theta(XY))$。
两个括号内都是弦 $XZ$ 所对的有向圆周角，分别以 $A,Y$ 为顶点，因此在模 $\pi$ 意义下相等。设它们都为 $\alpha$，所得方向差便为 $2\alpha-\alpha=\alpha$。
从 $X$ 经 $Y$ 到 $Z$ 的弧短于半圆，故普通角 $\angle XAZ$ 是锐角，且等于相应圆心角 $\angle XOZ$ 的一半。因此它正是所求的两直线夹角。

methods.title: Calculate both projection differences
methods.titleZh: 计算两对投影点的复数差
steps: Use the unit circle in the complex plane and lower-case letters for the vertices. For two distinct points $u,v$ on it the chord line has equation $w+uv\bar w=u+v$. Indeed its reflection map is $w\mapsto u+v-uv\bar w$, an orientation-reversing isometry fixing both endpoints. Hence the foot of $y$ is the midpoint of $y$ and this reflection, namely $(y+u+v-uv\bar y)/2$.

Subtract the two foot formulas at $X$, obtaining $q-p=(b-a)(1-x\bar y)/2$. At $Z$ the same calculation gives $s-r=(b-a)(1-z\bar y)/2$. Since $|y|=1$, their ratio is $(s-r)/(q-p)=(y-z)/(y-x)$. Thus the angle between the two projection lines equals the smaller angle between lines $YX$ and $YZ$.
Angle $XYZ$ intercepts the arc $XZ$ that omits $Y$, of size $2\pi-\angle XOZ$. Its ordinary size is $\pi-\angle XOZ/2$. Its supplement is acute and gives the required angle.
stepsZh: 在复平面用单位圆表示原圆，各点的小写字母表示其复坐标。对圆上两点 $u,v$，过它们的弦所在直线方程为 $w+uv\bar w=u+v$。事实上，$w\mapsto u+v-uv\bar w$ 是反向等距变换，固定两个端点，故是关于这条直线的反射。点 $y$ 的垂足是它与反射像的中点，坐标即 $(y+u+v-uv\bar y)/2$。
将过 $X$ 的两条直线所对应的垂足公式相减，得 $q-p=(b-a)(1-x\bar y)/2$。对过 $Z$ 的两条直线同理有 $s-r=(b-a)(1-z\bar y)/2$。利用 $|y|=1$，相除得 $(s-r)/(q-p)=(y-z)/(y-x)$。因此两条垂足连线间的锐角等于直线 $YX,YZ$ 间的锐角。
$\angle XYZ$ 截得不含 $Y$ 的弧 $XZ$，其弧度为 $2\pi-\angle XOZ$，故 $\angle XYZ=\pi-\angle XOZ/2$。它的补角为锐角，即所求夹角。

usajmo-2010-q4.summary: For every integer $n\ge 0$, construct three distinct lattice points on $y=x^2$ forming a triangle whose area is a perfect square. Its positive square root must be divisible by $2^n$ and by no higher power of $2$.
usajmo-2010-q4.summaryZh: 给定任意整数 $n\ge 0$，在抛物线 $y=x^2$ 上构造三个不同的整点，使所成三角形的面积为完全平方数，并且面积的正平方根恰好被 $2^n$ 整除而不能被 $2^{n+1}$ 整除。
usajmo-2010-q4.answer: Every $n$ occurs. For example, the square roots of the areas in the first three cases can be $1,6,36$ for $n=0,1,2$, respectively.
usajmo-2010-q4.answerZh: 每个 $n$ 都可以实现。例如，当 $n=0,1,2$ 时，可以分别取面积的正平方根为 $1,6,36$。

methods.title: Three small triangles and an area scaling
methods.titleZh: 三个起始三角形与面积伸缩
steps: Use the origin and the points $(a,a^2),(b,b^2)$, with integers $0<a<b$. Their area is half the determinant of the two position vectors, hence $T=ab(b-a)/2$.
Take $(a,b)=(1,2),(1,9),(6,24)$. The corresponding areas from this formula are $1,36,1296$, whose square roots $1,6,36$ contain respectively zero, one and two factors of $2$.

Write $n=3k+r$ with $0\le r<3$. Start with the pair for $r$ and multiply both abscissas by $4^k$. The new vertices on the parabola are still distinct lattice points. Each of the three factors $a,b,b-a$ gains a factor $4^k$, so the area gains $(4^k)^3=(2^{3k})^2$. Its square root therefore contains precisely $r+3k=n$ factors of $2$. Dividing it by $2^n$ gives the required odd integer.
stepsZh: 取原点以及 $(a,a^2),(b,b^2)$，其中 $a,b$ 为满足 $0<a<b$ 的整数。用两个位置向量的行列式计算，三角形面积为 $T=ab(b-a)/2$。
把 $n$ 写成 $3k+r$，其中 $0\le r<3$。选取对应于 $r$ 的那一对横坐标，再把二者都乘以 $4^k$。新取的抛物线上的三点仍是不同的整点。面积公式中的 $a,b,b-a$ 各扩大 $4^k$ 倍，因此面积扩大 $(4^k)^3=(2^{3k})^2$ 倍。面积平方根中因子 $2$ 的个数恰为 $r+3k=n$，除以 $2^n$ 所得的商就是所需奇数。

methods.title: Raise the exponent one step at a time
steps: Keep the first two vertices at $(0,0)$ and $(1,1)$, and take the third at $(t,t^2)$ for an integer $t>1$. The line through the first two vertices is $y=x$, and their vector determinant with the third gives area $t(t-1)/2$. At $t=2$ the area is $1^2$.
Suppose $t(t-1)/2=s^2$ and define $t^{\prime}=(2t-1)^2$. Then $t^{\prime}-1=4t(t-1)=8s^2$. It follows that $t^{\prime}(t^{\prime}-1)/2=\bigl(2(2t-1)s\bigr)^2$.

The new square root equals the old one times $2(2t-1)$. Since $2t-1$ is odd, this introduces exactly one additional factor of $2$. At each step $t^{\prime}>1$ is integral, so after $n$ steps the new triangle has the desired area.
stepsZh: 固定前两个顶点 $(0,0),(1,1)$，第三点取为 $(t,t^2)$，其中 $t>1$ 为整数。用两个位置向量的行列式可知，面积为 $t(t-1)/2$。从 $t=2$ 开始，面积为 $1^2$。
新面积的正平方根等于旧平方根的 $2(2t-1)$ 倍。由于 $2t-1$ 是奇数，因子 $2$ 恰好增加一个。每次得到的 $t^{\prime}$ 都是大于 $1$ 的整数，迭代 $n$ 次便得到满足条件的三角形。

usajmo-2010-q5.summary: Call two permutations of $1,\ldots,2010$ intersecting if they have the same value in at least one position. Construct $1006$ permutations such that each further permutation intersects a member of the family.
usajmo-2010-q5.summaryZh: 两个 $1,\ldots,2010$ 的排列只要在某一相同位置取值相同，就称它们相交。构造 $1006$ 个排列，使每个其余的排列都与所构造的某个排列相交。
usajmo-2010-q5.answer: Cyclically rotate the first $1006$ values in all $1006$ ways and leave the other positions fixed.
usajmo-2010-q5.answerZh: 将前 $1006$ 个数作全部 $1006$ 种循环移位，后面各个位置保持不动。

methods.title: Rotate a block larger than half
methods.titleZh: 循环移动超过一半的位置
steps: For each $r=0,1,\ldots,1005$, define $\pi_r(i)=1+((i-1+r)\bmod 1006)$ for $1\le i\le1006$, and $\pi_r(i)=i$ for $i>1006$. Each block rotation is a permutation. Their values at $i=1$ are distinct, so the family has the required size.

Take any permutation $\sigma$. Only $1004$ of its possible values lie outside $\{1,\ldots,1006\}$. Its first $1006$ positions cannot all receive these outside values because it never repeats a value. Thus some $i\le1006$ has $j=\sigma(i)\le1006$.
At that fixed position $i$, the values $\pi_r(i)$ run through $1,\ldots,1006$ once. Choosing $r\equiv j-i\pmod{1006}$ gives $\pi_r(i)=\sigma(i)$, as required.
stepsZh: 对 $r=0,1,\ldots,1005$，当 $1\le i\le1006$ 时规定 $\pi_r(i)=1+((i-1+r)\bmod 1006)$，其余位置取 $\pi_r(i)=i$。每次块内循环移位都给出一个排列，而且 $i=1$ 处的值互不相同，故共有 $1006$ 个。
取任意排列 $\sigma$。在 $\{1,\ldots,1006\}$ 之外只有 $1004$ 个数，排列又不能重复使用一个数，故前 $1006$ 个位置不可能全部取这些外部值。于是存在 $i\le1006$，使 $j=\sigma(i)\le1006$。
固定这个位置 $i$，所有 $\pi_r(i)$ 恰好遍历 $1,\ldots,1006$。取 $r\equiv j-i\pmod{1006}$，就有 $\pi_r(i)=\sigma(i)$，两排列在第 $i$ 位相交。

usajmo-2010-q6.summary: Triangle $ABC$ is right-angled at $A$. The internal bisector at $B$ meets $AC$ at $D$, and the internal bisector at $C$ meets $AB$ at $E$. Let $I$ be the intersection of $BD$ and $CE$. Can $AB,AC,BI,ID,CI,IE$ all have integer lengths?
usajmo-2010-q6.summaryZh: 在直角三角形 $ABC$ 中，$\angle A=90^\circ$。$B$ 的内角平分线交 $AC$ 于 $D$，$C$ 的内角平分线交 $AB$ 于 $E$，$BD$ 与 $CE$ 交于 $I$。$AB,AC,BI,ID,CI,IE$ 这六条线段的长度可以全是整数吗？
usajmo-2010-q6.answer: No. Even the four lengths $AB,AC,BI,CI$ cannot all be integers.
usajmo-2010-q6.answerZh: 不可以。仅 $AB,AC,BI,CI$ 这四个长度便不能全为整数。

methods.title: Compare two formulas for the hypotenuse
methods.titleZh: 比较斜边平方的两种表达式
steps: Write $u=BI$ and $v=CI$, both positive. In triangle $BIC$ the angles at $B$ and $C$ add up to half of $\angle ABC+\angle BCA$, namely $45^\circ$. The angle opposite $BC$ is therefore $135^\circ$.
The cosine rule in this smaller triangle and the Pythagorean theorem in the original triangle now describe the same length: $AB^2+AC^2=BC^2=u^2+v^2+uv\sqrt{2}$.

If the four lengths $AB,AC,u,v$ were integers, rearranging would give $\sqrt{2}=(AB^2+AC^2-u^2-v^2)/(uv)$ as a ratio of integers with a nonzero denominator. This contradicts the irrationality of $\sqrt{2}$. The additional lengths $ID$ and $IE$ cannot change that contradiction.
stepsZh: 记 $u=BI,v=CI$，二者都大于零。在三角形 $BIC$ 中，$B,C$ 两角之和是 $\angle ABC+\angle BCA$ 的一半，等于 $45^\circ$。因此，$BC$ 的对角是 $135^\circ$。
在三角形 $BIC$ 中利用余弦定理，在三角形 $ABC$ 中利用勾股定理，可得 $AB^2+AC^2=BC^2=u^2+v^2+uv\sqrt{2}$。
假设 $AB,AC,u,v$ 都是整数，移项可得 $\sqrt{2}=(AB^2+AC^2-u^2-v^2)/(uv)$。右边是分母非零的整数之比，与 $\sqrt{2}$ 为无理数矛盾。因此这四条线段的长度都不可能同时为整数，更不可能六条全为整数。
